title: After Hours: Vinyl Sessions
description: Two turntables, a hand-built sound system, and a crate of records collected one dance floor at a time. Resident DJ Mara Sol opens with downtown disco before handing the booth to Kito Bell for a late set of deep house.

title: Clay Club Open Studio
description: Pull up a stool at the shared clay table and spend the afternoon making a little dish by hand. Studio potter Elise Park demonstrates pinching and carving, then helps you choose a glaze. Clay and firing are included.

title: The Night Market
description: Follow the smell of scallion pancakes through Lantern Yard. Neighborhood cooks serve skewers, hand-pulled noodles, and warm sesame buns under strings of orange lights. Entry is free, and you can buy food directly from each stall.

title: The Tight Five
description: A cellar stage and a five-minute clock keep this midweek stand-up night moving. Six local comics try fresh material before host Dani Reyes brings the whole lineup back for one final audience suggestion.

title: Light Leaks: 16mm Shorts
description: Hear the projector click into gear for an evening of hand-spliced 16mm shorts. Filmmakers introduce their neighborhood portraits, stop-motion experiments, and camera-less films, then stay for questions after the last reel.

title: Winter Field Notes
description: Meet at the Grand Army Plaza entrance for a slow walk through the park. Naturalist Jules Reed points out winter buds, bird calls, and the shapes that help identify trees after their leaves have fallen. Bring a pencil for a little sketching.

title: Ink & Paper Print Fair
description: Browse tables of risograph prints, illustrated zines, and letterpress postcards from independent New York makers. Watch an artist pull a two-color screen print and take home a freshly inked sample while supplies last.

title: Blue Hour Quartet
description: Saxophonist Theo Lane brings his quartet into a small Harlem listening room for an evening of new arrangements. The first set draws on ballads, while the second leaves space for the rhythm section to stretch out.
